$note: Authorized deviations for the reference implementation (showcase, product=default). Established during Slice 1 calibration: the audit correctly flagged these; review confirmed they are intentional, so they are recorded here rather than 'fixed'.

deviations.value: near-canvas gradient-field stops (identity board atmospheric field)
deviations.why: Page-local convention (showcase :root comment 'per spec: not tokens'), keyed per theme, fading to transparent. The identity-board field is the visual thesis; its stops are derived-from-canvas atmosphere, not a palette.

The two non-amber demo hues in the showcase accent switcher, dark and light: spexr's indigo and introspect's cyan, both registered product accents (accent-registry.json). The switcher picks the pair member for the active theme (0.11: a dark-ground hue on paper failed contrast). They appear as demo swatch content so the page can show the per-product registry (design-language.md §Decision 2), not as a second accent adopted by the showcase. Blessed by exact value — they live in a JS object with no distinctive selector. Only the hue is listed now: hover/active/subtle are no longer hardcoded (the switcher sets only the hue and they re-derive), so the previous demo step-literals are gone.
